Name: Growable Ginger
Author: thesandmansleeps
Description:
You got the "island ingredients" quest and now you need 100 ginger. searching the island and killing tiger slimes aint cutting it is it? 
Well now you can just grow the ginger you need and make as much ginger ale as you want!
Put ginger into a seed maker to get ginger seeds. they take 7 days to grow and yield 2 + more based on your farming level and random chance.
No watering needed but they are a summer crop! (research says they need warmer weather and to take care not to over water them)
ENJOY!
